responsibility: Provides the analyzer module’s foundational shared header and utility declarations. It centralizes common GCC includes, forward declarations for the major analyzer subsystems (supergraph, regions, svalues, region_model, program_state, exploded_graph, state machines, diagnostics, and summaries), declares cross-cutting helper functions for tree/diagnostic formatting, JSON conversion, call recognition, and symbolic simplification, and defines small reusable infrastructure such as path_var, region_offset, path_context, auto_cfun, and generic hash/consolidation templates that many analyzer source files depend on.
